data.title: Nvidia, SpaceX, Microsoft launch AI safety initiative as OpenAI cyber attack fallout continues
data.description: Microsoft, SpaceX, Palantir, alongside dozens of other tech companies from the U.S. and Europe, have joined the Open Secure AI Alliance.
